name: Brute Force Response Playbook
description: Automated response workflow for brute force attack detection. Triggered by Splunk webhook alert. Classifies severity, blocks source IP, disables compromised account, enriches with threat intelligence, and notifies SOC analyst via Slack.

workflow_steps.description: Receives alert payload from Splunk via HTTP POST
Normalises and parses incoming alert data into structured fields
Classifies alert severity based on failed login count
workflow_steps.logic: if count > 20: HIGH, if count > 10: MEDIUM, else: LOW

workflow_steps.description: Routes workflow based on alert type and severity
Executes firewall rule to block source IP on Windows host via remote command
workflow_steps.command: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name='BLOCK_{{src_ip}}' dir=in action=block remoteip={{src_ip}}

workflow_steps.description: Disables compromised Active Directory account via PowerShell
Queries VirusTotal API to check reputation of source IP
Sends enriched alert to SOC analyst Slack channel
